faq.q: What is Sentinel in Grand Theft Auto VI?
faq.a: Sentinel is a fictional GTA car brand. In the Extended Look video, Jason and Lucia are shown driving an old Sentinel convertible, as identified by GamesRadar+.

faq.q: Does the Sentinel brand have a history in the GTA series?
faq.a: GamesRadar+ says the Sentinel brand's roots go back to Vice City, meaning it is not a new brand introduced for this game.

faq.q: What model of Sentinel do Jason and Lucia drive?
faq.a: The facts file only confirms the brand and that it is an old convertible. No specific model name is given by the sourced reporting.

faq.q: Where is the Sentinel convertible first seen in GTA VI?
faq.a: It is shown being driven by Jason and Lucia in the Extended Look gameplay video released on 27 August 2026.
